name: Olive Garden Alfredo Sauce
description: Let the sauce simmer as long as you can!
directions: In a saucepan combine butter, heavy cream, and cream cheese.
Simmer this until all is melted, and mixed well.
Add the Parmesan cheese and Garlic powder. Simmer this for 15 - 20 minutes on low. You may wish to season with a little salt and pepper.
I have done this with half and half, but we prefer the heavy cream. But I wouldn't try it with plain milk.
